pr_title: fix(es/codegen): Add quotes to property names when `ascii_only` is `true`

issue_context.title: ascii_only handles object attribute names missing double quotes
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

input: https://unpkg.com/lower-case@2.0.2/dist.es2015/index.js

```js
{
	Ì: "\u0069\u0307\u0300",
}
```
asciiOnly = true

```js
{
	 \xcc: "i\u0307\u0300",
}
```

`\xcc` should be in double quotes
